title: TabularQGAN
summary: A quantum-GAN research project (qugen) for tabular data synthesis, benchmarking a quantum generative model against classical GAN baselines. It wraps SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and CopulaGANSynthesizer as classical baseline synthesizers and uses SDV's SingleTableMetadata and evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic functions to evaluate generated tabular data.
